prompt.en: What is the name of the dialect spoken by the Métis?
prompt.fr: Quel est le nom du dialecte parlé par les Métis?

explanation.en: The Métis come from both French-speaking and English-speaking backgrounds and speak their own dialect, Michif.
explanation.fr: Les Métis viennent à la fois de milieux francophones et anglophones et parlent leur propre dialecte, le michif.

source.quote: They come from both French- and English-speaking backgrounds and speak their own dialect, Michif.

verification.evidence: The Métis are a distinct people of mixed Aboriginal and European ancestry … They come from both French- and English-speaking backgrounds and speak their own dialect, Michif.
